title: Which AI model — measured, not assumed
note: Same corpus, same prompts, same code. Cache keys include the model name, so the hosted run missed every local entry and genuinely re-queried — verified before measuring.
axes: Replies not in the closed vocabulary (of 33)
Label proposals a human would reject
edge_cases: All 20/20 planted edge cases correct on both providers.
caveat: DeepSeek is far better at following the format (zero malformed replies against qwen's 23) and worse at this corpus's category boundary — it calls 106 SI_REQUEST emails BL_COMPARISON where qwen gets 124 of 125 right. The prompt was developed against qwen and never adapted; rewriting it until the hosted number improved would be tuning against the answer key, so it was not done. qwen ships as the default.
